Our discussion will therefore move from planting targets to maintenance budgets. Finally, we will ask how a council can report survival rates instead of simply counting newly planted trees. These figures would describe different aspects of the same programme.

A shared office is worth considering provided that quiet spaces are genuinely available. My purpose is not to defend one layout for every workplace. It is to ask which activities a design supports and which it makes harder.

en-ielts-listening-u03.error: up to thirty 不等于 exactly thirty；省掉限定词会改变数据。

en-ielts-listening-u03.reading: Attendance at the evening workshop showed a modest decline after the room changed. This does not mean that learners lost interest in the subject. Several participants reported that the new venue required an additional bus journey. The organiser is considering an online replacement for one session each month. questions: Paraphrase a modest decline without strengthening it.
A slight fall.

en-ielts-listening-u08.reading: Today we have considered why repeated exposure alone may not produce flexible learning. Familiarity can make material feel easy even when a learner cannot explain it without prompts. Retrieval practice addresses this gap by requiring an answer before the source is reopened. Spacing such attempts across several days may also help, although the best interval depends on the material and the goal. Our classroom example illustrated a possible routine, not a universal prescription. Learners must still check mistakes and use knowledge in contexts different from the original exercise. The central message is therefore to combine recall, feedback and varied use rather than judge progress by the smoothness of rereading.

en-ielts-reading-u03.reading: Seed banks are often described as secure archives of future crops. Yet storing seeds is not equivalent to preserving a crop indefinitely. Some species tolerate drying poorly, and even suitable seeds require periodic testing. They show why conservation strategies also include living collections and cooperation with growers. The paragraph therefore examines the limits of a single method rather than narrating the history of agriculture.

Why one conservation method is insufficient.
